categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Keysino Separation Technology Inc. primarily operates in industrial fluid special separation, focusing on membrane separation technology applications. The company provides customized membrane separation technology solutions including clean production process design and implementation, membrane separation equipment integration, operational technical support, and after-sales services. Its products and services mainly serve industrial fluid process treatment and wastewater treatment sectors across industries such as chemical fiber, biopharmaceuticals, textile dyeing, petrochemical, coal chemical, new energy, pulp, and metallurgy.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary membrane separation application technologies combined with deep understanding of various membrane products and membrane separation techniques. It integrates membrane materials as core components into membrane separation system integrated devices. Production involves project-based implementation with independent process development, design, automation control programming, and outsourced component manufacturing. The company also develops advanced membrane materials and control systems, including high-concentration brine concentration devices and industrial waste alkali comprehensive utilization systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are industrial enterprises in sectors such as biopharmaceuticals, chemical fiber, textile printing and dyeing, petrochemical and coal chemical, new energy, and metallurgy. The company serves clients requiring industrial fluid process optimization, wastewater treatment, resource recovery, and clean production transformation. It also has international customers in Southeast Asia, Africa, South Asia, and Europe, providing integrated membrane separation solutions tailored to specific industrial wastewater treatment needs.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with headquarters and main operations in Shanghai and subsidiaries in Jiangsu and other regions. It has expanded its market presence internationally, with operations and customers in countries including Malaysia, Ethiopia, Pakistan, and other Southeast Asian, African, and South Asian countries. The company also has a wholly-owned subsidiary in Singapore.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai Keysino operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on the integration and application of membrane separation technologies and equipment for industrial fluid treatment. It procures membrane components and control systems from upstream suppliers and provides integrated solutions and services directly to industrial end-users.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous R&D investment to enhance technological innovation in membrane separation applications, focusing on expanding applications in chemical fiber, biopharmaceuticals, textile dyeing, petrochemical, coal chemical, new energy, electronics, new materials, food, and pulp industries. It pursues development of new membrane materials, control systems, and process technologies aimed at improving efficiency, reducing costs, and achieving zero discharge and resource recovery. Collaboration with universities and establishment of expert workstations support its innovation ecosystem.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of industrial fluid separation integrated solutions and membrane components, including replacement parts and consumables. The company also earns income from equipment leasing and operational services, including wastewater treatment service fees and recycled water fees, typically settled monthly. Sales are conducted primarily via direct sales supported by technical consulting and customized solution design.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Shanghai Keysino is positioned as one of the few domestic companies capable of providing comprehensive membrane separation technology solutions for industrial fluids. It holds a strong competitive position due to its proprietary technologies, extensive project experience, and customized service model. The company has received multiple high-tech enterprise recognitions and industry awards, distinguishing itself from competitors who may only supply membrane elements without integrated application expertise.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 81.6 million, a 34.52% decrease from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 1.65 million. Despite the revenue decline, operating cash flow improved significantly. The company has total assets of around RMB 792 million and equity attributable to shareholders of approximately RMB 634 million. It continues to invest heavily in R&D, with expenditures representing nearly 20% of revenue, indicating a focus on long-term growth despite short-term financial challenges.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shanghai Keysino differentiates itself by offering highly customized, integrated membrane separation solutions that optimize industrial fluid processes beyond mere wastewater treatment. Its technology enables recovery and reuse of valuable materials, reduces chemical consumption, lowers production costs, and minimizes environmental impact. The company combines deep industry knowledge with advanced membrane technology and smart operational management, providing clients with economic, environmental, and operational benefits that support clean production and green transformation.
